from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyFinancialRecord(BaseModel):
    """Financial data from one company's 10-Q filing for the period in question."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Company name as identified in the filing")
    period: str | None = Field(description="Period covered by the filing (e.g., period ended March 31, 2025)")
    
    net_income_value: float | None = Field(description="Consolidated net income/loss amount as reported (negative if loss)")
    net_income_label: str | None = Field(description="How the line item is labeled (e.g., 'Consolidated Net Income', 'Net Loss')")
    net_income_unit: str | None = Field(description="Scale of the net income value: 'millions', 'thousands', 'dollars'")
    
    operating_cash_flow_value: float | None = Field(description="Net cash from operating activities as reported (negative if used)")
    operating_cash_flow_label: str | None = Field(description="How the line item is labeled (e.g., 'Net Cash Provided by Operating Activities', 'Net Cash Used in Operating Activities')")
    operating_cash_flow_unit: str | None = Field(description="Scale of the cash flow value: 'millions', 'thousands', 'dollars'")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_financial_records: list[CompanyFinancialRecord]
